features.title: Keep localhost available when LAN access is enabled
features.summary: Add loopback-only TCP listeners to the existing concrete LAN-bound Web server without replacing routing, authentication or origin checks. Print the actual localhost launch URL first and the available LAN/advertised addresses after startup settles. Native loopback-only binds remain unchanged.
failureModes: An occupied loopback port rejects startup and rolls back listeners instead of taking over another application.
Unavailable IPv6 leaves the IPv4 loopback listener available; other listener failures are not hidden.
HTTPS is forwarded as TLS, so the supplied certificate must also cover localhost.
Localhost needs its own native launch-token login because authentication cookies are authority-bound.

features.title: Choose how DSH is reachable
features.summary: Choose LAN access and a concrete interface address, and set an advanced port. Localhost stays enabled independently of LAN access. Save desired preferences without interrupting current connections; a later user-controlled restart loads them. Explicit CLI flags keep priority.

configuration.constraints: Boolean desired access mode; null preserves the native profile fallback.
A current concrete non-loopback address is required when enabling LAN access.
0 chooses an available port; explicit ports are whole numbers 1–65535. CLI flags keep priority.

failureModes: Concurrent or invalid settings writes are rejected without replacing the user's desired configuration.
A saved address that disappears remains visible instead of silently exposing a different interface.
Custom native binding overrides stay read-only until the startup integration is installed; Save never live-migrates the native listener.
An old Host without the matching API displays an unavailable section rather than editable controls.
